tagline: Send every Magento email through Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Amazon SES or any SMTP service, with OAuth 2.0, an email log, automatic retries and plain-language diagnostics.
key_features: Presets for 10 providers plus any SMTP server
OAuth 2.0 for Google and Microsoft 365, including app-only
Send Test Email and Check Connection with readable errors
Email log with search, safe preview and resend
Automatic retries and optional background sending
Test addresses, log-only mode and a staging safety lock
DNS check for SPF, DKIM and DMARC
Settings per website and store view

benefits.title: Ready for OAuth
benefits.text: Microsoft 365 and Google expect OAuth instead of passwords. Connect once, or use Microsoft app-only sign-in that never needs reconnecting.

benefits.title: No lost emails
benefits.text: When the server is down or refuses a message, the email is kept and sent again later, and you can see and resend any email from the log.

benefits.title: Problems explained
benefits.text: Instead of "Unable to send mail", you read what went wrong and what to change: app password needed, blocked port, sender not allowed and more.

showcase.label: Settings
showcase.title: Pick a provider, enter the key
showcase.text: A preset fills in the server and security, and notes explain where to find the right password or API key. Every setting works per store view.

showcase.label: OAuth 2.0
showcase.title: Microsoft 365 and Google without passwords
showcase.text: Copy the redirect URI, enter the client ID and secret, and click Connect Account. Microsoft 365 also works app-only, with no sign-in at all.

showcase.label: Test
showcase.title: Test before you switch it on
showcase.text: Send a test email or just check the connection. You see the result in plain words and the SMTP conversation with passwords hidden.

showcase.label: Email Log
showcase.title: Every email, searchable
showcase.text: Status, email type, store view and the reason for any failure, with counts of the last 24 hours, filters and mass resend.

showcase.label: Email details
showcase.title: See it and send it again
showcase.text: A safe preview of the email, its attachments and headers. Send it again to the same recipients or to a corrected address.

showcase.label: DNS check
showcase.title: Find out why emails land in spam
showcase.text: SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX of your sender domain, checked against your provider and explained in plain words.

feature_groups.title: Sending
items: Gmail, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, Brevo, Postmark, Mailjet, Zoho Mail, Cloudflare
Custom servers with STARTTLS, SSL/TLS, PLAIN, LOGIN or CRAM-MD5
Send all emails from one address with Reply-To
Same behaviour on Magento 2.4.6 to 2.4.9, attachments and Bcc kept

feature_groups.title: Reliability
items: Readable explanations for common provider errors

feature_groups.title: Log and resend
items: Search by subject, sender or recipient; filter by status, type, store view and date
Safe HTML preview, text version, headers and attachments
Resend to the same or another address, single or mass

feature_groups.title: Staging and diagnostics
items: Send everything to test addresses or only log
Staging safety lock based on the live domain
Always-deliver list and Never Send To blocklist
Send Test Email, Check Connection and DNS check, also as CLI commands

works_well_with.text: Shows whether the email queue and retry job runs, and warns when cron stops.
Records who changed the SMTP settings and when.
